name: Comino in a day
description_md:
The Comino in a day route is a waymarked hiking route located in MT. This path covers a distance of 12.8 km and requires about 7.6 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The route is situated in MT. It is a waymarked hiking route that spans 12.8 km.

The total walking time is about 7.6 hours according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
